patterns.what_worked: Verified the origin/forever API truth before editing (UnitPower/UnitPowerMax SecretWhen*, StatusBar SetMinMaxValues/SetValue AllowedWhenTainted with the BarValue aspect, Blizzard's own raw mana-bar pass-through), then red-first tests before the additive api.GetPlayerPower reader and the StatusBar fill. Mutation proofs (6/6) plus an A/B crossfire control isolated this desk's changes from the concurrently edited main.lua/swing_source.lua lanes.
patterns.what_was_hard: Real secrets cannot be simulated in plain Lua: the suites model the restricted flag with unique sentinels and spy on the fraction/format seams, and the opaque-max case (a restricted max that looks empty) catches any comparison of a secret. The diag restricted pin belongs to tests/diag_state.lua, outside this desk's exact write scope, so it is proven ad-hoc and filed.
patterns.skill_gap: None blocking; the mutation script had to be written to keep every case in one shell invocation because /tmp is not shared between tool calls in this harness.
